# Technology Stack Decision

**Project:** Transparent_Bridge_Eth_to_Wifi
**Status:** Adopted (reverse-engineered from actual dependencies)
**Generated by:** brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0
**Last Updated:** 2026-08-17T12:39:36-07:00

---

## Technologies in Use

| Component | Technology | Source |
|-----------|------------|--------|
| Configuration management | Ansible (single `system` role, applied by `run.yml`) | `run.yml`, `roles/system/` |
| Target OS | Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm since commit `284b786`) | `roles/system/defaults/main.yml`, git history |
| WiFi access point | hostapd (WPA2-PSK, CCMP) | `roles/system/tasks/hostapd.yml`, `etc/hostapd/WifiRepeaterHostAPD.conf` |
| L2 bridging | systemd-networkd (`br0` netdev, eth0 member) | `roles/system/tasks/bridge.yml`, `etc/systemd/network/` |
| DHCP client control | dhcpcd (deny on bridged interfaces) | `roles/system/tasks/bridge.yml`, `etc/dhcpcd_bridging.conf` |
| DHCP relay (orphaned) | dhcp-helper | `roles/system/tasks/dhcp-helper.yml`, `etc/default/dhcp-helper` |
| Web server | lighttpd (SSL, custom error pages) | `roles/system/tasks/lighttpd.yml`, `etc/lighttpd/lighttpd.conf` |
| Service discovery | avahi (mDNS/DNS-SD) | `roles/system/tasks/avahi.yml`, `etc/avahi/avahi-daemon.conf` |
| E-paper display | Pimoroni Inky wHAT via Python 3 | `roles/system/tasks/inkywhatAP.yml`, `usr/local/bin/Device_Label_WifiAP.py` |
| Firewall persistence | nftables | `etc/nftables.conf`, `roles/system/tasks/final_cleanup.yml` |
| USB WiFi driver (optional) | aircrack-ng rtl8812au (8812au-20210629) built from source | `roles/system/tasks/AWUS036ACH_wifi_adapter.yml` |
| Web content | HTML5UP Dopetrope static theme | `var/www/html/html5up-dopetrope/` |
| Build environment | Docker-hosted Ansible container | `Readme.md` Setup instructions |
| Issue tracking | beads (bd) over local Dolt DB | `.beads/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` |

---

## Package Dependencies

Discovered in `roles/system/tasks/*.yml` (apt unless noted):

- **hostapd.yml:** hostapd
- **dhcp-helper.yml:** dhcp-helper (orphaned task)
- **lighttpd.yml / webservercontent.yml:** lighttpd
- **inkywhatAP.yml:** python3-qrcode, python3-icalendar; pip3: inky, netifaces, font-source-serif-pro (fonts)
- **AWUS036ACH_wifi_adapter.yml:** raspberrypi-kernel-headers, build prerequisites, rpi-source
- **essential.yml / final_cleanup.yml:** full package upgrade; gparted, vim, lightdm, ncdu, lshw

## Service Dependencies

systemd units configured or installed by the role:

- `hostapd.service` (AP daemon, bound to `br0`)
- `systemd-networkd` (bridge definition via `bridge-br0.netdev`, `br0-member-eth0.network`, `20-wired.network`)
- `avahi-daemon.service`
- `lighttpd.service`
- `Device_Label_WifiAP.service` + `.timer` (e-paper display refresh)
- Device registration service + timer (`roles/system/tasks/device_registration.yml`)
- `dhcp-helper.service` (only if the orphaned task were run)
- `nftables.service` (rules persisted from `etc/nftables.conf`)

---

## Notes

This document was reverse-engineered from the existing implementation. Actual technology selection decisions predate the multi-agent pipeline adoption. Known inconsistencies discovered at adoption (broken `inkywhat.yml` import, orphaned dhcp-helper task, Python 3.9 interpreter pin on a Bookworm target) are tracked in `docs/PRD.md` Open Questions and as beads issues.
